subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Her behaviour was so __ostentatious __that it attracted the attention of everyone in the room.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Restrained**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"ostentatious"** means characterized by vulgar or pretentious display; designed to impress or attract notice. (आडंबरपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** Her ostentatious outfit drew everyone's attention at the party.
 
 
 
• **"Restrained"** refers to being characterized by reserve or moderation; unemotional or dispassionate. (संयमित)
 
 
• **Example:** His restrained reaction to the news surprised everyone.
